Awaiting /reload and live retest.
Live retest after source timing fix produced no Slack prompt. New root cause: this runtime did not emit/deliver the ask_user waiting tool_execution_update path Casper relied on. Need a delayed fallback from tool_execution_start that posts after pi-ask-user registers its bridge, guarded against duplicate posts.

Clears timers on session start/shutdown/tool end. Verified pi-casper check, pi-ask-user test, and bun run check. Needs /reload and live retest.
Found Slack invalid_blocks root cause: option buttons reused the same action_id within one actions block. Slack requires action_id uniqueness inside the block. Verified representative ask_user Block Kit payload with chat.postEphemeral returned ok=true. Checks passed: node --check daemon, pi-casper check, bun run check.
User saw duplicate Slack ask_user prompts and answered twice. Root cause: scheduled fallback and update-event path could both enter forwardAskUserWaiting before the forwarded guard was set. Live retest: user saw one Slack prompt with buttons/questions, but clicking/after handling still produced ephemeral "That ask_user prompt is no longer available." History showed the card updated to "ask_user prompt cancelled." Patched daemon ask_user handling to: register prompt before Slack post completes, track toolCallId→promptId alias, mark prompts as submitting before sending to client, hide buttons while submitting, ignore completed/submitting/missing prompt clicks quietly instead of posting stale ephemeral, and clear submitting on result/tool end. close_reason: Fixed and live-tested Slack ask_user buttons: direct buttons render once, submit through Socket Mode, update the card to answer submitted, and no stale ephemeral is shown. title: Route pi-casper Slack slash input like TUI
description: Slack messages beginning with slash should behave like TUI input: extension commands such as /reload run as commands, and skill/template slash input such as /skill:name passes through normal expansion/steering.
notes:

True arbitrary extension/built-in command invocation from an extension is blocked by Pi API: pi.sendUserMessage intentionally skips command/template handling, and ExtensionContext does not expose AgentSession.prompt() or ctx.reload().

Example: Slackbot says /casper-status is not a valid command. Future design should not depend on leading slash text in channel messages; use a Slack-native slash command such as /casper with Socket Mode command payloads, or a non-slash text prefix like `casper status` / `!casper status`.

Implement two supported input paths instead: (1) normal channel text aliases such as `casper status` / `!casper status` that do not need app reinstall; (2) Slack-native `/casper <command>` via manifest slash command and Socket Mode `slash_commands` envelopes, requiring app reinstall with commands scope.

Broker restarted as pid 95855. App manifest must be updated/reinstalled in Slack before `/casper ...` works.
close_reason: Implemented a Slack-compatible command strategy. title: pi-casper Slack plan artifact review/approval integration
description:

## Required Skills

Started investigation. Existing pi-plan-mode writes standalone HTML plan, emits pi:notify plan-ready event, and supports headless /plan-approve, /plan-refine <changes>, /plan-exit. Existing Casper can route Slack text into a mapped session and run a small set of local slash controls, but does not yet handle pi:notify, custom plan-result payloads, Slack interactive block_actions, modals/view_submission, file upload, or plan artifact rendering.
Investigation findings: pi-plan-mode writes a standalone HTML plan path, emits pi:notify with source=pi-plan-mode kind=ready and dedupeKey plan-ready:<path>, and already supports approve/refine/exit via /plan-approve, /plan-refine, /plan-exit. Slack file upload should use files.getUploadURLExternal + raw upload + files.completeUploadExternal; manifest needs files:write. Playwright is resolvable in the repo but Chromium is not installed locally; rendering requires playwright browsers (e.g. npx playwright install chromium) or a fallback that posts controls without artifact. Recommended design: plan-mode emits a structured plan-review-ready event or extends pi:notify with planFilePath; Casper client forwards plan_ready to broker; broker renders PDF/PNG with JS disabled/network blocked, uploads file(s), posts Block Kit controls; broker handles block_actions and view_submission to approve/refine/exit through a small pi-plan-mode external bridge, falling back to slash command injection only if needed. Slack supports global feedback via modal text, not inline annotations on the PDF/PNG; inline review remains the local browser review UI.
